Article id: configure-online-appointment-booking
Article: Set up and manage online appointment booking for patients
Enable patients to schedule routine visits directly through the web and mobile portal by configuring your scheduling rules. Only providers with active schedules and visit types marked as 'Online Eligible' will appear to patients.

1. Go to **Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules**.
2. Toggle on **Allow Online Appointment Booking**.
3. Navigate to **Scheduling > Visit Types**, select a visit type, and check the box for **Available Online**.
4. Under **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability**, designate which staff members accept online requests.

**Limits & Conditions:**
Patients can only book appointments between 24 hours and 60 days in advance. Urgent visit types cannot be made available online.

**Troubleshooting:**
If a provider does not appear for booking, verify their schedule template is published and that their assigned rooms are active under **Settings > Facility > Rooms**.

Ticket:
Online booking restrictions

How do I restrict online patient bookings to specific providers and visit types? I need to stop patients from scheduling procedures through the portal. Please provide instructions.

Auto-reply:
1. Open **Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules** and turn on **Allow Online Appointment Booking**.
2. Go to **Scheduling > Visit Types**. For each visit type you want to allow, check **Available Online**; for procedures and any other types you want to block, leave the box unchecked.
3. Open **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability** and select only the providers whose schedules should be visible for online booking.
4. Ensure the providers you selected have published schedule templates and active rooms (see the troubleshooting note if a provider is missing).
Patients will now be able to book only the enabled visit types with the designated providers, and procedures will not appear in the portal.
